name: MakerBot Replicator Z18 1 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; makerbot_tool_type=[smart_extruder_type]
; generated_by=Orca Slicer
; --- MAKERBOT Z18 START (Orca coordinates) ---
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0
G90 ; absolute coordinates
G1 X260 Y7.5 Z5 F9000 ; safe height for prime start (front right)
G1 Z0.24 F600 ; to prime line height
M83 ; relative extrusion for prime line
G1 E5 F200 ; anchor
G1 X50 Y7.5 E18 F1000 ; prime line across the front
G1 E-0.5 F1500 ; short retract
G1 Z2 F600 ; lift nozzle
G1 X150 Y152.5 F9000 ; move to center
G1 Z[first_layer_height] F600 ; first layer height
G1 E0.5 F1200 ; Unretract
machine_end_gcode:
; ===== MB Z18 END (Orca coordinates) =====
M400 ; wait for all moves to finish
G92 E0 ; reset E
G1 E-5.0 F2400 ; retract (snaps the filament string)
G1 Z{max(405, max_layer_z)} F180 ; lower bed near bottom, capped so firmware +50mm stays under Z458
G1 X295.5 Y304.5 F6000 ; move off object to safe park column (X145.5 MakerBot)
M104 S0 T0 ; heater off
M141 S0 ; chamber off
M107 ; fan off
M73 P100 ; progress 100%
; firmware then adds +50mm and shuts down
; ===== END =====
